datasets_util.groups
====================

.. py:module:: datasets_util.groups

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Provides utilities for working with groups of
   columns in metadata organized as Pandas Dataframe.

.. py:class:: ColumnsGroup(dataframe: pandas.DataFrame, columns_to_be_grouped: list)

   .. py:attribute:: columns


   .. py:attribute:: df_groupby


   .. py:method:: get_group(group_key: Union[tuple, list]) -> pandas.DataFrame

      Get the DataFrame for a specific group key.

      :param group_key: A tuple of values corresponding to the columns in self.columns, in the same order.
      :type group_key: tuple or list

      :returns: The DataFrame containing all rows that match the group key.
      :rtype: pd.DataFrame



.. py:function:: select_best_in_group(group: pandas.DataFrame, segments: pandas.DataFrame, required_modalities: set = {'ecg', 'ppg', 'bioimp'}) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Select the best quality segment for each required modality from a group.

   :param group: DataFrame with rows for a single participant/session/datetime combination
   :type group: pd.DataFrame
   :param segments: DataFrame with segment information including file_id, modality, and quality_indicator
   :type segments: pd.DataFrame
   :param required_modalities: Set of modalities to select (default: ecg, ppg, bioimp)
   :type required_modalities: set

   :returns: DataFrame with one row per modality (the best quality segment for each)
   :rtype: pd.DataFrame
